title: How to Earn in Crypto with Colend Token? High APR on Gate.io Launch Pool!
description: Today, we’re diving into the new Colend launch pool on Gate.io! This project offers a high APR and unique features like liquidity provision and lending on Core Chain. We’ll assess the CLND token’s potential, the risks, and the key metrics. Is Colend worth a long-term investment? Share your thoughts in the comments, and don’t forget to subscribe for more crypto insights. 📈#EarnWithCrypto #Colend #CryptoLaunchpool #GateIO #BTCFi #CryptoInvesting #DeFi #PassiveIncome #CoreChain #LiquidityMining #CryptoGems #CryptoNews #Bitcoin #Altcoins #DeFiProjects #CryptoMarket #APR #Tokenomics

asr.full_text: The new launch pool at Gate.io gives you opportunity to earn crypto without any risk. Do you want to know how? Hello everybody, I'm Crypto Fatalist, and I will tell you about it. Launch Pool is a process where users stake their crypto assets to earn rewards in the form of new project tokens during a token launch event. Today we're focusing on Gate.io's launch pool for the Colind token. Colind is the premier decentralized lending protocol on core chain, currently the fastest-growing BTC sidechain. BTCFI is transforming Bitcoin into a productive asset by enabling yield opportunities through lending and staking, all while enhancing Bitcoin's long-term security. Let's break down the CLND pool. A total of 80,000 tokens will be distributed, with an impressive APR of 464%. That's around a 1.5% daily return. On the other hand, if we look at the Core pool, there will be 53,333 tokens distributed at an APR of about 90%. Although this is a lower yield, Core is a more stable asset. Now let's dive deeper into the project. Colend already has a fully diluted valuation, FDV, exceeding $15 million, and its trading volumes are steadily growing. So far, Gate.io's platform has collected only $80,000, but it's still early days in the launch pool. The project's tokenomics are also appealing, with half of the total supply allocated for liquidity mining, which could help sustain the token price long-term. Additionally, with token unlocks scheduled in December, we might anticipate price dips on those dates. Colend's official website is impressive, outlining key goals, features like liquidity provision, loan options, earning rewards, and announcing an upcoming NFT drop for users. Next, let's check out their Twitter. While they have 70,000 followers, the engagement could be stronger, suggesting it might still be an under-the-radar gem. It's also promising to see venture fund HTX, Binance, and Aptos among their followers. If you have questions, drop them in the comments. Let's keep the discussion going. In summary, CoLend is an intriguing project, but I would approach it cautiously for long-term investment. So, if you want to earn money with it, don't forget to subscribe to my Telegram channel but I would approach it cautiously for long-term investment.
